profile_text.body:
SAIC is a publicly traded company, listed under the ticker SAIC, that describes itself as a provider of AI services. On its own site it says it was recognized as a worldwide leader in AI services in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide AI Services for National Civilian Government 2025 Vendor Assessment, and as a leader in AI services in the IDC MarketScape: U.S. Defense and Intelligence Agencies AI Services 2025 Vendor Assessment.

The site presents applied AI as a way for defense leaders to achieve decision dominance by turning large volumes of data into fast, mission-ready insight. It also describes RAG-R as redefining national security and warfighting AI through secure deployment, real-time knowledge updates, and structured, trustworthy reasoning. No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are recorded for the company.
